quote: Natale Oscar Farinetti was born in Alba, Piedmont.

claim: The first Eataly opened on January 27, 2007 in a converted vermouth factory in Turin's Lingotto district.
quote: the first Eataly opened its doors in Torino on January 27, 2007, when an old vermouth factory was transformed into Eataly Torino Lingotto – the very first multifunctional marketplace dedicated to Italian excellence in the world.

claim: Oscar Farinetti opened the first Eataly in January 2007 in a closed vermouth factory in Turin's Lingotto district.
quote: In January 2007, Italian businessman Oscar Farinetti opened the first location of Eataly, converting a closed vermouth factory in the Lingotto district of Turin.

claim: Alba's weekly market is held every Saturday across Piazza Risorgimento, via Cavour, via Vittorio Emanuele, Piazza Marconi and Piazza Garibaldi.
quote: The Alba market (mercato) is held every Saturday, whatever the season and weather may be. Piazza Risorgimento, via Cavour, via Vittorio Emanuele, Piazza Marconi and Piazza Garibaldi transform into a huge supermarket under the sky.

claim: Slow Food's Mercato della Terra in Alba runs Saturdays 8 a.m.–1 p.m. in Piazza Elvio Pertinace, separate from the main town market.
quote: Piazza Elvio Pertinace, Alba (Cn) … Saturday from 8.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m, Sundays from 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. (mid-September to November)
